status: research-only; all 105 keys pending; no disposition or credit

method.parser: existing reproduce_uganda_2006_county_center_overlay.py standard-library shapefile/dbf and ray-crossing routines
method.coordinate_source: already-retained complete-537-feature-center-overlay.json; no coordinates copied into this output
method.projection: embedded .prj WGS84 UTM Zone 36N; central meridian 33 degrees; k=0.9996; false easting 500000m; custom false northing 200000m
method.test: point-in-polygon for each of the 105 registered Kinkiizi center-contact keys against all 164 UBOS county polygons

limits: The UBOS archive has conflicting ISO/ESRI projection metadata; this comparison follows only the embedded .prj definition.
This compares recorded cell centers, not whole cells or physical support.
The official UBOS 2006 county dataset is a distinct product; same name/year and polygon containment do not prove source equivalence or territorial applicability.
No legal/current ownership finding, source clearance, repair, hold removal, package completion, or acceptance is inferred.
All 105 keys remain pending pending source-specific review; the 116 Irumu/Kimvula proposal keys and other 709 residual keys remain separate.
